occurrences.pixelObservations: Location: center below the tilted luminous display and above the ringed white figure and 2+. Outer shape: an upright near-square panel with strongly rounded corners, a thick continuous pale-gray border, a thin dark outer shadow, and a nearly opaque charcoal-black face. Internal marks: extremely faint gray alphanumeric-looking traces occur near the upper-left interior, while dark-red diagonal background strokes remain visible across the face; no recoverable central pictogram is present. Colors: black, charcoal, light gray, white, and faint dark red.
occurrences.closestAlternative: An empty framed slot or placeholder rather than a symbol-bearing square object.
occurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The closed high-contrast rounded frame clearly bounds a dark panel, but its interior contains no reliably separable symbol, icon, or readable text.
occurrences.uncertainty: The faint interior marks are below reliable legibility and do not establish a semantic identity.

occurrences.pixelObservations: Location: centered below the dark rounded square, directly left of 2+ and above SABOTAGE. Outer shape: an unenclosed, approximately bilateral solid-white figure with a rounded head, narrow neck, broad shoulders, short side projections, a tapering torso, and two lower projections, seated in several concentric horizontal elliptical rings. Internal marks: the head is featureless; dark gaps separate the side projections from the central body and divide the lower pair; the rings have pale-cyan highlights, electric-blue rims, dark-blue interiors, and visible intervening gaps. Colors: white, pale cyan, electric blue, dark blue, and black.
occurrences.closestAlternative: The displayed p.40 general/character glyph, which is a segmented astronaut-like figure.
occurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The source has a solid featureless head and body surrounded by blue rings; general/character has a broad dark visor, articulated segmented limbs, multiple torso voids, and no rings.
